SIKARAPID® AF: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaRapid® AF, June 2023, Version 01.03 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/8/sikarapid_af.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaRapid® AF where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (June 2023, Version 01.03).
1.2 Product description. SikaRapid® AF is a non chloride set accelerator for concrete and mortar.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. SikaRapid® AF is recommended for use in premix and precast concrete where accelerated setting time is required. As a result, SikaRapid®-AF allows:
    - Faster finishing of concrete surfaces.
    - Improved early strength of premixed concrete.
    - Faster slip-form movement.
    - Used in ready mix concrete in cold weather.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.5.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaRapid® AF
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Ac - Non Chloride Set Accelerator
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates. SikaRapid® AF meets and exceeds all requirements of Australian Standard 1478.1-2000 for Accelerator (Ac).
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Can be used alone or in conjunction with a water reducer or a superplasticiser.
    - Faster demoulding
    - Reduces the risk of damage by freezing when pouring with cold temperature by shortening the plastic phase of the concrete.
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Density: 1.42 kg/l
2.5 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Bulk deliveries; 10 litre pails
    - Shelf life: Stored at temperatures between 5° C and 35° C in unopened original containers protected from direct sunlight and from frost, shelf life is 12 months.
    - Storage conditions: Store SikaRapid® AF at 5°/35°, protected from the direct sunlight.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (June 2023, Version 01.03) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (June 2023, Version 01.03) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Recommended dosage: Dosage is 400ml - 2000ml/100 kg of total cementitious material. Exact dosage rate should be determined by site trials.
4.3 Compatibility. SikaRapid® AF can be used in conjunction with any non-retarded Sika plasticiser or superplasticiser. It is beneficial to add SikaRapid® AF with the initial mixing water before the addition of superplasticiser to enhance strength development. Tests must be carried out to determine the optimum combination. Do not useSikaRapid® AF in conjunction with shrinkage compensating admixtures.
4.4 Dispensing. SikaRapid® AF is added to batching water or is poured into the concrete mix at the same time as the gauging water. SikaRapid® AF may also be added into the agitator truck on site. In this case, the concrete should then be mixed for an extra 1 minute for every cubic metre of concrete. The concrete should then be checked visually for uniform consistency before discharging.
4.5 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Frozen SikaRapid®-AF may be used after it has been carefully thawed at room temperature and thoroughly stirred.
    - Where concrete with low cement content is being supplied, higher dosage rates should be used.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.5):
    - Frozen SikaRapid®-AF may be used after it has been carefully thawed at room temperature and thoroughly stirred.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaRapid® AF, June 2023, Version 01.03, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/8/sikarapid_af.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS SikaRapid® AF, version 22/08/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/m/sds-sikarapid-af.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SikaRapid AF, version 17/07/2023, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/x/SikaRapid%C2%AE%20AF%20GHS7.pdf
    - Environmental Product Declaration: EPD SikaRapid® AF, version 12/11/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/b/epd-sikarapid-af.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
